PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Susan Redfield, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Silissa Uriarte Smith, Vice Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Stephen Scott, Acting Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  CHRISTINE.AMAYA@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month – June and August 2025

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56444  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the LA 2028 Olympics from
  the Office of the City Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-56445  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, August 21, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-56446  Recommendation to discuss fee waiver requests received between August 14,
  2025 and September 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-56447  Recommendation to authorize the Acting Director, or his or her management
  designee, to execute the Personal Services and Instruction Agreements and
  amend Attachment "A" of the agreements as needed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 3
   PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  25-56457  Recommendation to approve Special Event Permit Application #26-040 from
  Partners of Parks, a California nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled
  “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado Nature Center on October 4, 2025, that includes
  the sale and consumption of alcohol beverages, with parameters determined by
  the Office of Special Events and Filming and the Department of Parks, Recreation
  and Marine; or,

  Determine the proposed activity does not provide overall public benefit and deny
  Special Event Permit Application #26-040 from Partners of Parks, a California
  nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado
  Nature Center. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56460  Recommendation to authorize the Acting Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine
  to amend Right-of-Entry Permit No. P-00309 to include backstop improvements at
  Stearns Champions Park for fields one and two, to Long Beach Little League, a
  California nonprofit organization. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56462  Recommendation to receive and file the Director’s monthly highlights report, “We
  Create Community” and “Director’s Highlights” for September 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Parks, Recreation and Marine Administration
Office at (562) 570-3170.
